references: Seven screenshots supplied by user showing low-resolution painterly gothic castles, floating ships and dramatic sculptural clouds. They serve as art-direction reference, not embedded assets.
thesis: Pixel-dithered volumetric gothic wasteland with oversized architecture and pools of amber light.
composition: Side-on cathedral walker fills left third; three stepping stones form a visible vertical choice on right; rich spiral storm and abandoned towers occupy horizon.
rendering: Canvas 2D, 360 logical pixels, ordered 4x4 palette dithering for per-pixel clouds, low-resolution authored geometry for foreground.
focalAsset: Four-legged bell tower with riveted feet, two side towers, chimneys, lit window arches and gears.
rejected: procedural cubes pretending to be a fortress
authorship: Original game code and procedural visuals. No embedded third-party image assets.
motion: Tap sparks, leg lift, body swing, landing dust, resource readout; reduced-motion shortcut.

alternatives.reason: Texture and mesh production would dominate instead of completing gameplay.
Would require multiple authored images and reduce atmosphere variation.
Chosen to create a dynamic scene within app runtime.
